name: Opposite Trade
summary: This EA opens opposite (hedging) positions against existing trades when a specified drawdown threshold is reached. It acts as a loss recovery mechanism by opening reverse trades with adjustable lot multipliers to hedge against adverse price movement.
summary_zh: 该EA在现有持仓达到指定浮亏阈值时，自动开立反向对冲仓位。通过可调的手数倍数开立反向交易来对冲不利价格波动，作为一种亏损恢复机制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于对冲恢复：当现有持仓浮亏达到设定的阈值时，EA自动开立反向仓位进行对冲。入场条件是当前持仓的浮亏超过InpLossForOpposite参数指定的点数或金额阈值。出场条件依赖于对冲仓位的盈利覆盖原仓位亏损，或由用户手动关闭。仓位管理采用可调的倍数系数（LotMultiplier），对冲仓位的手数可以大于原仓位以加速回本。资金管理方面，EA允许设置最大对冲次数限制以防止无限开仓。但该策略本质上是一种有限马丁格尔变体，在极端单边行情中仍面临风险。整体而言，这是一种被动防守型策略，而非主动进攻型交易系统。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on hedge recovery: when an existing position's floating loss exceeds a configured threshold, the EA automatically opens an opposite position to hedge. Entry condition is triggered when current position drawdown surpasses the InpLossForOpposite parameter threshold in points or monetary value. Exit conditions depend on the hedge position's profit covering the original position's loss, or manual closure by the user. Position sizing uses an adjustable multiplier coefficient (LotMultiplier) where the hedge position's lot size can exceed the original to accelerate breakeven recovery. Money management includes a maximum hedge count limit to prevent unlimited position opening. However, the strategy is essentially a limited martingale variant and still faces risk in extreme trending markets. Overall, this is a defensive recovery strategy rather than a proactive trading system.

parameters.name: InpLossForOpposite
parameters.description: 触发对冲的浮亏阈值（点数）
parameters.description_en: Floating loss threshold in points to trigger hedge

parameters.name: MaxOppositeTrades
parameters.description: 最大对冲交易次数限制
parameters.description_en: Maximum number of hedge trades allowed

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

parameters.name: InpStopLoss
parameters.description: 对冲仓位的止损点数，0为不止损
parameters.description_en: Hedge position stop loss in points; 0=disabled

parameters.name: InpTakeProfit
parameters.description: 对冲仓位的止盈点数，0为不止盈
parameters.description_en: Hedge position take profit in points; 0=disabled

pros: 提供自动对冲机制，在持仓浮亏时及时保护账户
手数倍数可调，灵活控制对冲力度和恢复速度
最大对冲次数限制防止无限开仓导致过度暴露
操作简单，参数直观易懂
可作为现有手动或自动交易的补充保护工具
pros_en: Provides automatic hedging mechanism to protect account during adverse positions
Adjustable lot multiplier offers flexible control over hedge intensity and recovery speed
Maximum hedge count limit prevents unlimited position opening and over-exposure
Simple operation with intuitive and easy-to-understand parameters
Can serve as supplementary protection for existing manual or automated trading
cons: 本质上带有马丁格尔属性，连续对冲可能导致仓位过大
没有止损保护的情况下极端行情风险极高
依赖原持仓方向正确性，对冲只是延缓而非解决问题
对冲仓位如果也亏损会导致双向亏损的困境
未考虑点差和手续费成本对对冲效果的影响
cons_en: Essentially carries martingale attributes where consecutive hedging can lead to oversized positions
Extreme market risk without stop loss protection in place
Depends on original position direction correctness; hedging only delays rather than resolves the problem
Hedge position losses can lead to dual-direction loss dilemma
Does not account for spread and commission costs impact on hedging effectiveness
improvements: 添加全局止损和账户权益保护机制，防止极端情况下账户爆仓
引入趋势过滤器，在强趋势中避免盲目对冲而选择直接止损
增加盈亏比计算和自动平仓逻辑，在对冲达到目标时自动关闭所有关联仓位
improvements_en: Add global stop loss and account equity protection mechanism to prevent account blowup in extreme scenarios
Introduce trend filter to avoid blind hedging during strong trends and opt for direct stop loss instead
Add risk-reward ratio calculation and auto-close logic to close all related positions when hedge target is reached

risk_points: 对冲本质上是马丁格尔变体，连续加仓风险递增
缺少全局止损可能导致极端行情下巨大亏损
手数倍数设置不当会加速账户资金消耗
未考虑点差成本对高频对冲的侵蚀效应
risk_points_en: Hedging is essentially a martingale variant with escalating risk from consecutive position increases
Lack of global stop loss can lead to massive losses in extreme market conditions
Improper lot multiplier setting accelerates account depletion
Does not consider spread cost erosion effect on high-frequency hedging
